topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: On-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation by prioritizing immediate services, which do not require on-board memory, over time-tagged services. This is because time-tagged services must be stored in limited on-board memory between upload completion and operation starting times, potentially impacting power allocation due to increased latency and resource utilization.
